title: Senior / Lead Computer Vision Engineer
description:
**About CarCutter**
-------------------


At CarCutter, we are redefining automotive sales with AI\\-powered image technology that helps dealerships and marketplaces sell more vehicles, faster.


Our platform transforms the vehicle photography workflow with hyper\\-realistic 3D backgrounds, interactive 360° spins, precise cut\\-outs, grounded shadows, and consistent branding. By integrating advanced AI models into every stage of the process, we help businesses produce high\\-quality vehicle imagery at scale, while improving efficiency, engagement, and conversion.


CarCutter is a cutting\\-edge SaaS solution trusted by leading players in the automotive industry.


Visit CarCutter

**Location:** Paris, Place de Clichy, 75008  

**Work model:** Hybrid, with two remote days per week

**About the team**
------------------


Our team develops AI and computer vision technologies that improve the way automotive images are created, enhanced, and distributed.


You will join a compact (3 persons) team collaborating closely with software engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions from research to production.

**A recent project: NextGen360**
--------------------------------

**NextGen360 is the next generation of CarCutter’s 360° product, powered by generative AI.**


It transforms the four standard vehicle views already captured, front, rear, left side, and right side, into an interactive 360° video experience.


Unlike traditional 360° solutions, it does not require a dedicated capture session or a second walk around the vehicle. This technology enables a faster, more scalable, and more efficient way to create interactive vehicle experiences.

**The role**
------------


As a **Senior / Lead Computer Vision Engineer**, you will own computer vision and generative AI features from research and prototyping through to production deployment.


This is primarily an individual contributor role, with an approximate split of **80% hands\\-on technical work and 20% technical leadership**. You will help guide and support the team, without being responsible for managing a large organization.


At CarCutter, you will work on production\\-grade AI systems in a highly competitive market. We actively explore state\\-of\\-the\\-art technologies, including image and video generation models while maintaining high standards for quality, efficiency, scalability, and commercial viability. This extends to the way of working itself, where it is expected every engineer uses and continues to learn about AI tooling to accelerate the work.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own computer vision and generative AI features end to end, from research and prototyping to staging and production deployment.
* Evaluate state\\-of\\-the\\-art computer vision and generative AI technologies, including open\\-source models and API\\-based solutions, using rigorous benchmarks based on real\\-world use cases.
* Design, implement, and optimize production\\-grade pipelines, with a strong focus on inference performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Help the team move faster by sharing technical context, processes, resources, and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to integrate AI solutions into customer\\-facing products.
* Assess the maturity and business relevance of the latest advances in computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI.
* Contribute to technical decisions and help balance image quality, robustness, performance, and commercial constraints.
* Write clear technical documentation covering system design, model behavior, evaluation methods, and operational considerations.
* Support the team through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and mentoring.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* A Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related field.
* At least 6 years of industry experience in AI, machine learning, or computer vision.
* Strong programming skills in Python and deep expertise in PyTorch.
* Hands\\-on experience across the computer vision stack, including:


	+ Classical image and signal processing.
	+ Deep learning\\-based perception models, such as segmentation, detection, and refinement.
	+ Generative models, including diffusion architectures.
* A proven ability to take AI systems from concept to production, including deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\\-technical audiences.
* The ability to align technical decisions with business priorities and constraints.
* A high degree of ownership, autonomy, and pragmatism.
* A results\\-driven mindset suited to a fast\\-moving and competitive environment.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Contributions to open\\-source AI or computer vision projects.
* Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for machine learning systems.
* Experience deploying and operating machine learning models in the cloud, preferably on AWS.
* Experience optimizing model inference performance.
* Previous experience providing technical leadership or mentoring engineers.

**Do not hesitate to apply if you have never held a lead role but wish to do so.**

**What makes this position interesting?**
-----------------------------------------

##### **Work on high\\-impact AI features**


You will work on the core product and see the impact of your work every day. Our solutions are used by real customers at scale, which means your technical decisions directly influence the product and its business outcomes.

##### **Work with large and diverse datasets**


Our processing pipeline handles approximately **100 million images per year**. This real\\-world data comes from a wide range of environments and use cases, creating challenging and meaningful computer vision problems to solve.

##### **Access high\\-quality training data**


Our quality control teams in India support data labelling and curation, helping us build reliable datasets for training and evaluating our models.

##### **Help shape the future of the market**


CarCutter is pushing the boundaries of automotive visual production. With projects such as NextGen360, we are introducing new standards in the market.

##### **Join a compact and ambitious team**


Over the past two years, we have significantly increased our focus on technology and accelerated our innovation roadmap. You will join a collaborative team where technical contributions are visible and have a direct impact on the product.

**Hiring process**
------------------

* **Initial call:** A conversation with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.
* **Technical interview:** A discussion about your technical expertise, followed by more details about the role and the team.
* **Technical assessment:** A live coding session designed to assess your coding skills and problem\\-solving approach. The session may include practical agentic coding scenarios, as well as a discussion of your technical decisions and methodology.
* **Final interview:** A conversation with CTO \\& VP Product to discuss your fit with the team and company culture.
* **Reference check.**

**Budget**
----------


75/90k€ package including 5/10% variable

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.**

  

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.


We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system\\-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.


Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.


We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

  

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

**Field Deployment Engineer \\- Parallel**
-----------------------------------------

**Context**


Parallel is a healthcare platform deploying AI, RPA, and computer use solutions across healthcare facilities. We need someone capable of technically leading these deployments on the ground, adapting to real\\-world environments and the specific constraints of each facility.

**Your mission**


Be the technical interface between the Parallel platform and our clients. Technically lead end\\-to\\-end deployments by understanding each facility's IT infrastructure, adapt our platform to their constraints (interfaces, integrations, security, network architecture, on\\-prem deployments), and unblock projects by getting hands\\-on with the product when needed.

**Outcomes**

* Successful and stabilized Parallel deployments at client sites
* Technical adaptations and integrations tailored to each facility
* Rapid upskilling on our AI stacks, RPA/computer use, interoperability, and on\\-prem infrastructure
* Identification and resolution of technical and organizational blockers
* Clients supported through change management and able to use Parallel effectively
* Progressive definition of our deployment standards

**This job is for you if:**

* You have 5\\+ years of full\\-stack experience
* You're strong in Node.js \\& TypeScript (NestJS, Express, Prisma, Postgres) and React (TanStack, Tailwind)
* You've played with LLMs and AI agents — whether on side projects or professionally (LangChain, Hugging Face)
* You enjoy working directly with clients
* You thrive in complex, non\\-standardized environments
* You have a strong ability to quickly understand problems, take ownership, and find pragmatic solutions
* You're an engineer with a field/customer mindset (not a pure consultant or project manager)

**Hiring process**

* Call with our recruiting team
* Quick call with Chris, our CTO
* Case study at our Paris office
* Meeting with Paul, our CEO

**Why should you join us?**

* Real traction. Seed and Series A closed in under a year, with Index Ventures on the cap table. This isn't a maybe — it's a company that's moving.
* A problem worth solving. Cutting hospital admin directly gives time back to care teams. The impact is tangible.
* A genuinely different technical approach. Agents that work on top of existing systems without heavy integration is a real competitive edge — and you'll be the one building it.
* A team that has done it before. The founders have built and scaled before (Hublo, Meta, McKinsey). High standards, low ego.
* Actual ownership. You won't be handed a backlog. You'll co\\-build the architecture and set the engineering culture from the ground up.
* Competitive salary and equity package, premium health insurance (Alan), Swile meal vouchers, latest Apple equipment, Paris office (Strasbourg Saint\\-Denis).

**We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.**  

  

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Using generative AI to simulate chemically disordered nuclear materials at the atomic level H/F
description:
**Description du poste**
------------------------

### **Domaine**


Mathématiques, information scientifique, logiciel

### **Contrat**


Post\\-doctorat

### **Intitulé de l'offre**


Using generative AI to simulate chemically disordered nuclear materials at the atomic level H/F

### **Sujet de stage**


This postdoc aims to enhance PULSE, a generative (VAE) method revolutionizing predictions for disordered materials. You'll improve its accuracy, uncertainty quantification, and transition to a continuous latent space within a CEA consortium combining nuclear physics and AI.

### **Durée du contrat (en mois)**


24

### **Description de l'offre**

  

How do you predict a material's properties when the number of possible atomic configurations exceeds 2^2500? That is the bottleneck our IRESNE (nuclear fuel physics) and LIST (AI) teams have just cracked with PULSE, a generative (VAE) method published in Nature Scientific Reports, already cutting computational cost by more than two orders of magnitude (22,282 CPU hours down to 85 on a test case). With no known equivalent in the international literature, PULSE positions CEA as a pioneer in generative sampling of the configuration space of chemically disordered materials.


This 24\\-month postdoc gives you the opportunity to drive this method toward its next generation, leading three ambitious, parallel research axes: pushing model accuracy on systems of several thousand atoms with an IWAE architecture; equipping it with the ability to quantify its own uncertainty — a prerequisite for any use in nuclear safety; and, in the second year, tackling a high\\-value exploratory axis — generalizing PULSE to a continuous latent space, opening the door to any disordered crystal or alloy.


You will work at the heart of an all\\-CEA consortium bringing together two complementary strengths — atomistic nuclear fuel physics at IRESNE and state\\-of\\-the\\-art generative AI at LIST — with access to CEA supercomputers, the freedom to publish in top\\-tier journals, and the prospect of seeing your results feed directly into reactor safety analyses through the PLEIADES platform.


A position built for a curious mind who wants to combine cutting\\-edge generative AI research with concrete impact on a strategic nuclear\\-energy challenge.

 *\\#CEA\\-List ; \\#Research Engineer*


### **Profil du candidat**


You hold a PhD in Physics, Applied Mathematics, or Computer Science, with experience in deep generative models (VAE, diffusion) and Python/PyTorch.  

Applications from statistical physicists are welcome.

  

  

**STILL HESITATING?**  

The additional benefits of your mission might interest you:

* A cutting\\-edge research ecosystem, unique in its field and dedicated to high\\-impact societal themes, giving meaning to your work.
* Training programs to strengthen your skills, acquire new ones, and enhance your mission.
* A work\\-life balance recognized by our team members.
* Remote work options to reduce commuting time and improve your quality of life.
* A rich employee benefits committee (CE) with social, cultural, and sports activities.
* A dynamic workplace at the heart of a vibrant hub, surrounded by schools and tech companies.

 **Interested? Apply—this position is perfect for you!**

  

  

*In line with the CEA’s commitment to inclusivity, this role is open to all. The CEA offers accommodations and/or organizational adjustments to support workers with disabilities.*

### **Localisation du poste**

### **Ville**


Saclay
**Demandeur**
-------------

### **Disponibilité du poste**


01/11/2026

  

  

**Informations générales**
--------------------------

### **Entité de rattachement**

Le CEA est un acteur majeur de la recherche, au service des citoyens, de l'économie et de l'Etat.
  

  

Il apporte des solutions concrètes à leurs besoins dans quatre domaines principaux : transition énergétique, transition numérique, technologies pour la médecine du futur, défense et sécurité sur un socle de recherche fondamentale. Le CEA s'engage depuis plus de 75 ans au service de la souveraineté scientifique, technologique et industrielle de la France et de l'Europe pour un présent et un avenir mieux maîtrisés et plus sûrs.
  

  

Implanté au cœur des territoires équipés de très grandes infrastructures de recherche, le CEA dispose d'un large éventail de partenaires académiques et industriels en France, en Europe et à l'international.
  

  

Les 20 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs du CEA partagent trois valeurs fondamentales :
  

  

* La conscience des responsabilités
* La coopération
* La curiosité


### **Référence**

2026\\-41364
### **Description de l'unité**


Le LNHB, est le laboratoire national de métrologie pour la dosimétrie, essentiellement dans les domaines de la radiothérapie, de l'imagerie médicale ainsi que de la radioprotection des patients et des travailleurs. Il a pour mission la maîtrise et la connaissance la plus précise possible des doses délivrées, notamment au patient en radiothérapie et en imagerie. Pour remplir cette mission, le LMD développe de l'instrumentation (calorimétrie, ionométrie, gels ou solutions dosimétriques, dosimétrie par alanine, spectrométrie X), utilise des logiciels de pilotage des chaines de mesures (LABVIEW) et de traitements de données (PYTHON), et maîtrise et utilise plusieurs codes de transport des rayonnements dans la matière (PENELOPE, MCNP, EGS). L'activité du LMD est, pour sa majeur partie, réalisée sur la plateforme DOSEO (www.plateformedose.com), plateforme des technologies pour la radiothérapie et l'imagerie associée.

description:
**About CarCutter**
-------------------


At CarCutter, we are redefining automotive sales with AI\\-powered image technology that helps dealerships and marketplaces sell more vehicles, faster.


Our platform transforms the vehicle photography workflow with hyper\\-realistic 3D backgrounds, interactive 360° spins, precise cut\\-outs, grounded shadows, and consistent branding. By integrating advanced AI models into every stage of the process, we help businesses produce high\\-quality vehicle imagery at scale while improving efficiency, engagement, and conversion.


CarCutter is a cutting\\-edge SaaS solution trusted by leading players in the automotive industry.


Visit CarCutter

**Location:** Paris, Place de Clichy, 75008  

**Work model:** Hybrid, with two remote days per week

**About the team and platform**
-------------------------------


Team is responsible for supporting and evolving the core CarCutter platform.  

Building and releasing new features, improve customer satisfaction, and ensure that the platform remains scalable, reliable, and easy to operate as the business grows.


Over the past two years, we have been modernizing our technology stack and architecture. This includes progressively moving from a monolithic backend to a service\\-oriented architecture, with dedicated storage and clearer ownership across services. This transformation is still ongoing, and some legacy components remain to be decomposed or replaced.


You will help shape how we build and operate software in the cloud, make better use of AWS services, and improve the speed, reliability, and scalability of our systems.


You will work with Flavio, our Engineering Manager, Joffrey and Sebastien, Senior Backend Engineers closely with François and the wider Product, Design, and Engineering organization.

**The role**
------------


As a **Senior Backend Engineer**, you will work on the core systems behind CarCutter’s image processing platform.


Our Python backend integrates with multiple APIs that trigger image\\-processing workflows and connect to our computer vision services. We use SQL databases and message queues to manage images and deliver results directly to customer systems.


You will help ensure the smooth flow of images across our platform, operate reliable containerized Linux services, and monitor and improve our AWS infrastructure. You will also contribute to our engineering practices, including source code management, automated testing, documentation, and CI/CD.


This role also offers the opportunity to help define the next generation of software development at CarCutter. We are introducing AI coding agents and agentic workflows across the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and technical specifications to implementation, testing, code review, documentation, incident investigation, and operational improvements.


We are looking for someone who is curious about these new ways of working, while applying strong technical judgment and taking full ownership of the resulting software.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services in Python.
* Build flexible and reliable solutions that meet customer and product requirements.
* Improve and operate our AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Support the transition from our legacy monolith to a more modular and scalable architecture.
* Improve automated testing, including unit and end\\-to\\-end testing.
* Develop and maintain APIs, database integrations, message queues, and image\\-processing workflows.
* Apply DevOps practices to make computer vision capabilities reliably available to all customers.
* Monitor systems, investigate incidents, and continuously improve platform reliability and performance.
* Contribute to architecture, security, documentation, CI/CD, and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with application, frontend, cloud, data, and AI teams across the organization.
* Use AI coding agents and agentic workflows where they improve engineering outcomes, including implementation, refactoring, test creation, research, documentation, and incident response.
* Help define how agent\\-assisted work should be reviewed, tested, secured, monitored, and deployed safely.
* Evaluate new agentic practices and turn successful approaches into repeatable workflows.
* Share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, high\\-quality engineering culture.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* At least five years of experience in backend software development.
* Strong expertise in Python.
* Hands\\-on experience with Linux, including system administration and networking fundamentals.
* Experience working with SQL databases and queue\\-based processing.
* A solid understanding of software architecture, APIs and protocols, containers, security, and distributed systems.
* Experience with software development best practices, including TDD, BDD, automated testing, documentation, and CI/CD.
* Experience developing, operating, and monitoring cloud\\-based solutions, preferably on AWS.
* Strong source code management practices, preferably with Git.
* A proactive and pragmatic approach to problem\\-solving.
* A strong sense of ownership and attention to quality.
* The ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross\\-functional team.
* Professional working proficiency in English.

### **AI\\-assisted development**

* Experience using AI\\-assisted development tools or coding agents in real engineering work, or a strong interest in adopting them thoughtfully.
* The ability to critically assess AI\\-generated code and recommendations, including their correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational impact.
* An interest in improving not only software, but also the workflows used to specify, develop, review, and operate it.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with Terraform.
* Experience with AWS services such as API Gateway, Lambda, ECS and RDS.
* Experience operating image\\-processing or data\\-intensive systems.

**Why join CarCutter?**
-----------------------

### **Work on the core of the platform**


You will work on the systems that power the entire CarCutter product. Backend services are central to every customer workflow and every major product initiative.

### **Collaborate with every engineering team**


The backend team works closely with application, frontend, cloud, data, and AI teams. You will contribute to a wide range of projects and solve problems across multiple areas of the platform.

### **Have a direct impact on customers**


Your work will directly influence platform reliability, product capabilities, and the customer experience. The backend team is on the critical path for delivering the company’s vision and meeting customer needs.

### **Help modernize the architecture**


You will contribute to an ongoing transformation from a monolithic backend to a more modular, scalable, and cloud\\-native architecture.

### **Join an ambitious and collaborative team**


You will work in a dynamic startup environment with a strong focus on collaboration, technical quality, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

**Dev @ CarCutter**
-------------------

* We are ambitious and set challenging objectives for ourselves.
* We continuously improve our products, technology, and ways of working.
* We are a team of passionate people who value collaboration.
* We use AI and automation to expand what engineers can accomplish, not to replace judgment, collaboration, or accountability.
* We encourage experimentation while maintaining high standards for reliability, security, and maintainability.
* We turn successful tools and workflows into shared practices across the engineering organization.

**Hiring process**
------------------

* **Introductory call:** A video call with Talent Acquisition
* **Hiring manager interview:** A conversation to get to know each other and discuss the role in more detail.
* **Technical assessment:** An assessment reflecting the real work at CarCutter, including practical agentic coding scenarios and a discussion of your technical decisions and problem\\-solving approach.
* **Final interview:** A conversation with our CTO.


Even if you do not meet every qualification, we would still be happy to hear from you if you have relevant experience and a strong interest in the role.

### **About us**



The “Institut Curie” is a major player in the research and fight against cancer. It consists of a hospital and a Research Center of more than 1000 employees with a strong international representativeness.


The objective of the Curie Institute Research Center is to develop basic research and to use the knowledge produced to improve the diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutics of cancers as part of the continuum between basic research and innovation serving the patient.


### **Mission**



Contexte


Institute Curie is recruiting a Research Engineer) or Scientist in Artificial Intelligence (M/F) to join the AGORA project (AGentic Orchestration for Research and Clinical Applications in Oncology).


The ambition of AGORA is to design and validate one of the first agentic AI platforms fully dedicated to biomedical research and precision oncology. The platform will be capable of exploring complex biological data, integrating the latest medical knowledge, assisting molecular interpretation, and generating novel research hypotheses. To achieve this goal, AGORA combines large language models (LLMs), biomedical knowledge bases, bioinformatics tools, multi\\-omics datasets, and clinical data into a unified reasoning framework.


The project brings together experts in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science, specialists in health data integration and governance, researchers in systems biology and mechanistic modelling, as well as oncologists actively involved in precision medicine programmes.


The successful candidate will work at the interface of these different groups and will join the Bioinformatics Core Facility and INSERM U1331 Computational Oncology Unit, a highly interdisciplinary environment comprising approximately 100 researchers working in computational biology, bioinformatics, and artificial intelligence.

The position is central to the project and aims to develop the scientific and technological foundations of a new generation of AI assistants for oncology.

* Experience monitoring model performance, data quality, and drift.
* Experience implementing evaluation frameworks for LLMs, RAG systems, or AI agents.

 **Personal Skills**

* Strong problem\\-solving abilities.
* Rigorous and quality\\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating within multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong communication skills.
* Interest in research and innovation.

 **Why Join Us ?**


AGORA offers a unique opportunity to help shape the next generation of AI systems for oncology by working on real\\-world scientific and clinical challenges alongside leading researchers and physicians.


The project brings together several of the most exciting areas of modern artificial intelligence, including large language models (LLMs), multi\\-agent systems, knowledge graphs, multi\\-omics data integration, biological modelling, and clinical decision support.

description:

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R\\&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **BSP and Reference Images:** Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions.
* **Boot Chain and Secure Boot:** Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update.
* **Drivers and Low Level Interfaces:** Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces.
* **Board Support on MCU Targets:** Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs.
* **Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation:** Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary.
* **Verification and Documentation:** Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone.
* **Cross Functional Collaboration:** Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration.
* **Mentorship:** Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers.

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* **Educational Background:** MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree.
* **Experience:** 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved.
* **Build Systems:** Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage.
* **Technical Expertise:** Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image.
* **Boot and Update:** Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout.
* **Programming:** Strong C and C\\+\\+, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git).
* **Debugging Expertise:** Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf.
* **Professional Attributes:** Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.
* **Additional Skills:** Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages.
* **Commitment:** 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.


We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (TypeScript)
description:
Who we are
CryptoNext Security is a deeptech startup specializing in post\\-quantum cryptography. Our solutions help businesses and institutions prepare for a future where quantum computers will challenge traditional data security. We work with leading clients in finance, defense, and telecommunications.


On a daily basis, you will* Own features end to end in TypeScript: Hono and Node.js on PostgreSQL, React SPA on the front.
* Design HTTP APIs consumed through Hono's typed RPC client, with generated OpenAPI specs.
* Model and query PostgreSQL: schema, migrations, query performance.
* Build interfaces with Vite, TanStack, Tailwind and shadcn/ui.
* Work directly with Product and QA.
* Write the unit and integration tests that back your features, and give QA what they need to automate the rest.
* Review code.
* Use AI coding tools as leverage under your own judgement, staying accountable for what lands in the repo.
* Propose upgrades and refactorings, and explain the trade\\-offs you accepted.


How we work
A team of six engineers, within our 15\\-person R\\&D department. A single TypeScript monorepo, with shared types and tooling across services and front. Three days a week in our Paris office, the rest remote. Short feedback loops, high standards. We ship a working version early rather than polishing in isolation, and keep solutions as simple as the problem allows. Our products ship on\\-premise, sometimes into air\\-gapped environments, so builds have to be reproducible and dependencies deliberate. We build software our clients rely on for security: secure defaults, reviewed dependencies and tested code are part of shipping, not a later phase. We care more about a decision you can justify than a pattern you can name.

 **Requirements**  

  

The skills you'll need* Strong TypeScript across the stack: strict mode, generics, types shared between server and client instead of duplicated.
* Node.js backend: API design, auth, error handling, observability.
* Asynchronous processing: queue consumers and background workers, idempotency, retries and failure handling, backpressure.
* PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations and rollbacks, indexing, reading a query plan.
* Strong React: hooks, composition, clear state boundaries, client\\-side routing and server state caching.
* Comfortable with a modern frontend toolchain: fast bundling, utility\\-first styling, component libraries you extend rather than fight.
* API contract design: REST, OpenAPI, typed clients, versioning.
* Unit and integration testing, with a defensible position on what belongs at which level and on what is worth testing at all.
* Real use of AI\\-assisted development in a production codebase: agentic workflows, context management, reviewing generated output as critically as a colleague's merge request. You have a view on where these tools pay off and where they create debt.
* Seniority means you can say why you chose an approach, what you rejected, and what it will cost in six months.


Bonus skills* Go, used in parts of our codebase.
* Hono typed RPC and end\\-to\\-end type inference.
* Secure coding practices and application security.
* Basic understanding of cryptography and cybersecurity.
* Experience in a startup or deeptech environment.

 **Benefits**  

  

The team you'll be joining
You will join a team of six engineers who own their features across the whole stack, inside our 15\\-person R\\&D department, working closely with Product and QA. You will report to the Head of Engineering and collaborate with other departments to build the backend services and interfaces our clients depend on.


Our recruitment process
1\\. **Initial discussion** with our HR team to explore your background and motivations.


2\\. **Technical interview** with a developer: a live coding session of 1 to 1\\.5 hours. AI coding tools are required, not merely allowed. We are interested in how you direct and review them. No take\\-home assignment.


3\\. **Meeting with a manager** to ensure alignment with our company culture.


4\\. If successful, you'll receive a final offer!


What's in it for you at CryptoNext* A stimulating work environment with cutting\\-edge technological challenges.
* A competitive salary, aligned with our compensation philosophy.
* A deep dive into the exciting world of post\\-quantum cryptography and cybersecurity.


Ready to join the adventure? **Apply now!**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high\\-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software.


As a Flight Control \\& Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning\\-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement\\-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **System Identification:** Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds.
* **Control Law Design \\& Tuning:** Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope.
* **Sim\\-to\\-Real:** Keep the in\\-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft.
* **Model Consumption:** Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control.
* **Flight Test \\& Diagnosis:** Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs.
* **Mentorship:** Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior control and GNC engineers.

* **Educational Background:** A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, controls, robotics, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.
* **System Identification \\& Control:** Proven, hands\\-on identification and control on multirotor or fixed\\-wing platforms, validated in flight, with depth in at least one of MPC, INDI, or geometric control.
* **Embedded Realization:** Real\\-time control implementation on constrained targets, split cleanly between a microcontroller and a companion computer.
* **Learning\\-Based Control:** Familiarity with reinforcement learning and simulation\\-based training, and the judgment to know when a learned policy beats a classical design.
* **Professional Attributes:**


	+ Empirical and hardware\\-honest, disciplined about experiments and validation, grounded in real flight data.
	+ Communicates clearly, able to present control and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.
	+ Thrives under pressure in a fast\\-paced environment with a no\\-task\\-is\\-too\\-small mentality.
* **Bonus:** Multi\\-airframe or hover\\-to\\-cruise transition experience.
* **Commitment:** 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high\\-impact technology.


We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description:

You will develop low\\-noise, high\\-fidelity signal chains supporting quantum\\-device control and readout, from room\\-temperature electronics through cryogenic interconnects and device packaging.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.  

  

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security]\\[ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.  

  

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

  

* Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

  

* Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

  

* Participate in the team on\\-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high\\-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

  

* Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade\\-offs between short\\-term needs and long\\-term maintainability.

  

* Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post\\-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

  

* Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

  

A day in the life  

You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.  

  

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.  

  

On an on\\-call week, you triage a high\\-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow\\-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.  

  

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.  

  

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

  

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why Amazon Security?  

  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  

  

Training \\& Career Growth  

  

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge\\-sharing, training, and other career\\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

  

We value work\\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

title: Ingénieur IA – Large Language Models (LLM)
description:
Vous êtes


En tant qu’AI Engineer opérationnel (*hands\\-on*), vous serez au cœur de la conception et du développement des composants qui constituent les systèmes d’IA avancés alimentant les entreprises modernes. Il s’agit d’un rôle d’ingénierie hautement technique et pratique dans lequel vous consacrerez la majorité de votre temps à la conception détaillée, au développement, à l’intégration et aux tests de composants de systèmes d’IA couvrant le machine learning traditionnel, l’IA générative et les systèmes agentiques, dans le cadre de missions clients actives.


Vous prendrez des architectures détaillées et des spécifications de conception afin de les transformer en composants logiciels fonctionnels et prêts pour la production. Cela implique d’écrire un code propre et structuré, de prendre des décisions de conception de bas niveau dans votre périmètre de responsabilité et de garantir une intégration fiable de vos composants au sein d’un système d’IA plus large. Vous développerez et assemblerez les différents composants des systèmes d’agents IA, notamment la logique des agents individuels, les intégrations avec les outils, les skills et les composants de mémoire (*memory components*), tout en contribuant au développement et à l’intégration de foundation models ainsi que de modèles de machine learning traditionnels dans des pipelines de bout en bout (*end\\-to\\-end pipelines*).


Une curiosité pratique pour l’écosystème open source est essentielle pour ce rôle. Vous évaluerez, apprendrez et adopterez en permanence des bibliothèques et frameworks pertinents couvrant notamment l’orchestration d’agents, le stockage vectoriel (*vector storage*), le *model serving* et les pipelines ML. Vous sélectionnerez et appliquerez les solutions les plus adaptées à chaque problématique. Vous serez également amené à configurer, intégrer et mettre en production des technologies d’IA tierces ainsi que des services de plateforme, en comprenant suffisamment leurs capacités et leurs contraintes pour les exploiter efficacement dans le contexte d’un système d’entreprise à grande échelle.


Vous concevrez des composants répondant aux standards d’une organisation de niveau entreprise (*enterprise\\-grade*), en veillant à respecter les exigences définies en matière de sécurité, d’observabilité, de gouvernance, de performance et de scalabilité. Vous rédigerez et maintiendrez les livrables techniques associés à vos travaux d’ingénierie, notamment les documents de conception détaillée (*low\\-level design documents*), les spécifications de composants et les contrats d’intégration (*integration contracts*), afin de garantir que vos développements soient correctement documentés, testables et facilement transférables.


Vous interviendrez en tant que contributeur technique au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires composées de Data Engineers, ML Engineers et développeurs applicatifs. Vous travaillerez sous la direction de Lead Architects et Principal Architects tout en participant activement à la résolution de problématiques techniques ainsi qu’aux discussions de conception dans votre domaine d’expertise.


Ce poste représente une excellente opportunité de développer une expertise pratique approfondie sur l’ensemble de la stack AI Engineering, de renforcer vos compétences en ingénierie logicielle appliquées aux systèmes d’IA de pointe et d’évoluer progressivement vers un poste de Lead Engineer ou d’Architect.


Vos missions

* Concevoir, développer et configurer des agents individuels, y compris leurs prompts, outils et skills, puis les intégrer dans des workflows multi\\-agents.
* Mettre en œuvre la logique d’orchestration des agents afin de gérer les transferts de tâches, la communication et la reprise après erreur.
* Concevoir des frameworks d’évaluation et des suites de tests permettant de mesurer la qualité des agents et des composants selon des critères tels que l’exactitude (*accuracy*), la pertinence (*relevance*) et la fidélité (*faithfulness*), puis partager les résultats afin d’alimenter les améliorations de conception.
* Intégrer des foundation models dans les applications en sélectionnant le modèle et le mode d’invocation les plus adaptés à chaque cas d’usage.
* Concevoir et exécuter des pipelines de fine\\-tuning incluant la préparation des données et l’entraînement des modèles afin de les adapter à des domaines métiers spécifiques, en s’appuyant sur une bonne maîtrise des architectures basées sur les Transformers.
* Développer des pipelines d’ingestion capables d’analyser, segmenter (*chunk*), enrichir et indexer du contenu d’entreprise non structuré pour des besoins de recherche et de restitution.
* Mettre en œuvre la génération d’embeddings, intégrer des bases de données vectorielles et développer les composants de *retrieval*, y compris les connecteurs et adaptateurs permettant d’alimenter des pipelines RAG (Retrieval\\-Augmented Generation) de bout en bout.
* Développer la logique permettant d’assembler les prompts et de gérer les informations transmises au modèle au sein de sa fenêtre de contexte (*context window*).
* Implémenter des composants de mémoire permettant de stocker et de restituer l’historique conversationnel ainsi que le contexte pertinent.
* Mettre en œuvre des guardrails, des mécanismes de filtrage de contenu et des protections contre les attaques de type prompt injection.
* Développer des composants de détection et de masquage des données personnelles (*PII Detection \\& Redaction*) et intégrer les mécanismes de contrôle d’accès aux modèles et aux outils.
* Mettre en œuvre les mécanismes de versionning, d’audit logging et de traçabilité (*lineage tracking*), tout en maintenant une documentation garantissant l’auditabilité du système.
* Instrumenter les composants avec des mécanismes de logging et de tracing afin de suivre les requêtes, les réponses, la consommation de tokens et les appels aux outils.
* Contribuer aux activités de monitoring, d’alerting et de suivi des coûts afin de garantir la stabilité et la performance des systèmes d’IA en production.
* Assurer une veille continue et appliquer de nouveaux patterns de conception, technologies et frameworks issus d’un écosystème IA en constante évolution, afin d’apporter de nouvelles approches aux composants développés.
* Collaborer avec les équipes pluridisciplinaires afin de clarifier les besoins et de garantir que les composants développés répondent aux attentes des parties prenantes.
* Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire pour les composants développés afin de faciliter le support, le troubleshooting et les évolutions futures.

  

Formation

* Diplôme de niveau Bachelor en Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science ou dans une discipline d’ingénierie équivalente.


Compétences requises

* Expérience professionnelle ou académique dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions IA avancées combinant IA agentique, IA générative et machine learning traditionnel sur au moins une plateforme Cloud.
* Expérience professionnelle ou académique dans les domaines de l’Agentic AI, des Large Language Models (LLM) et de la Generative AI.
* Expérience dans la conception et la mise en production d’architectures applicatives basées sur les LLM.
* Expérience dans le développement logiciel ainsi que dans la conception de solutions de Machine Learning, Deep Learning et NLP (Natural Language Processing).
* Expérience en développement Python.

description:
Founded in 2020 and based in the heart of Paris, C12’s mission is to be at the center of one of the biggest technological breakthroughs of the century and change the course of history by building a universal quantum computer.
At C12, we believe that achieving a true breakthrough in quantum computing requires rethinking the fundamentals. That’s why our founders—deeply rooted in academic and engineering excellence—have chosen carbon nanotubes as the building blocks of our quantum processors. This ultra\\-pure material dramatically reduces error rates, boosts performance, and minimizes hardware overhead—key ingredients for scalable, fault\\-tolerant quantum computing. By crafting a unique approach that scales, we aim to revolutionize quantum computing just as silicon transformed classical computing.

Since our founding, we’ve raised over €25 million in funding, published 11 scientific papers, and secured 8 patents. Today, our fast\\-growing team of 80\\+, including 25 PhDs, has over 26 nationalities represented. We have our own cutting\\-edge lab spaces in Paris' historic Panthéon district, where scientists, engineers, and innovators work side\\-by\\-side to tackle some of the most exciting technical challenges of our time.

If you're passionate about shaping the future of quantum technology and want to make a real impact, C12 offers a unique environment to grow, learn, and innovate.
### **You role at C12 Quantum Electronics:**



C12 Quantum Electronics is developing a hybrid quantum architecture based on spin qubits in carbon nanotubes, coupled through a circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) platform. Our approach combines the exceptional coherence properties of carbon\\-based qubits with high\\-connectivity microwave architectures, with the goal of building a fault\\-tolerant quantum processing unit.



The Qubit Control team sits at the heart of this effort. We develop the methods that make qubits work: tuning protocols, readout strategies, gate implementations. We optimise the control and readout electronics and protocols, explore large parameter spaces, investigate the physics of the spin qubit, and translate physical insight into engineering solutions.



Working at the intersection of quantum physics, engineering, and software, you will collaborate daily with theory and the other engineering teams — all co\\-located in our Paris lab to make those interactions as direct and continuous as possible.



A company at an inflection point: C12 is transitioning from a phase of scientific discovery and proof\\-of\\-concept demonstrations to one of systematic scaling. This means our focus is shifting towards automation, reproducibility, and process maturity — without sacrificing the scientific rigor and curiosity that got us here. It is a demanding and exciting moment: we are still making new science, while simultaneously building the infrastructure that will carry us to a quantum advantage demonstration. The person joining this team will need to be both a rigorous scientist and a pragmatic builder.

  


Key responsibilities:

* You will design, calibrate, and optimize DC and microwave experiments in dilution cryostats equipped with state\\-of\\-the\\-art high\\-frequency control electronics
* You will develop scalable measurement and analysis workflows: well\\-documented, reproducible, and built to run with increasing autonomy
* You will sustain a close feedback loop with engineering teams to continuously improve device performance
* You will work closely with the theory team to connect experimental observations with physical models
* You will actively collaborate with the software team to execute our automation roadmap — from experiment scheduling to data analysis — as we scale toward a full QPU
* You will deepen our understanding of spin qubits in carbon nanotubes integrated within high\\-impedance cQED architectures
### **About you:**


* You are driven by the scientific and engineering challenge of building a quantum computer, and you want to contribute to a meaningful milestone in the field
* **You hold a PhD** (or Masters with substantial research experience) in quantum physics or a closely related discipline, **you have additional experience as post\\-doctoral researcher or in the industry**
* You have hands\\-on experience with quantum experiments — Qubits, DC transport, microwave spectroscopy,...

description:
*Le descriptif de l’offre ci\\-dessous est en Anglais*
**Type de contrat :** CDD


**Niveau de diplôme exigé :** Bac \\+ 5 ou équivalent


**Fonction :** Doctorant


**Niveau d'expérience souhaité :** Jeune diplômé


**Contexte et atouts du poste**
-------------------------------


**Hired by EDF under a CIFRE PhD Contract.**


**General Positioning**



Artificial intelligence (AI) began revolutionizing digital services in 2013 with its application to image processing and computer vision. A second revolution arrived around 2020 with language models (e.g., ChatGPT). More recently, AI has begun to be applied to scientific and engineering problems. Its goal is to create an "augmented engineer" who can carry out studies and make decisions with greater efficiency. In this context, digital twins appear as fundamental tools for the engineering of the future. A digital twin is a virtual model of an industrial piece of equipment. It covers the object's entire life cycle and uses real\\-time data sent by sensors on the object to simulate its behavior, monitor operations, and anticipate its functioning. Partial differential equation (PDE) solvers are a key element in simulating dynamics, but their execution times, even on supercomputers, make them difficult to deploy for digital twins subject to strong reactivity constraints.



Meta\\-models (or surrogate models) are approximations of classical numerical solvers with a very low computational cost. They form the core of a digital twin. Using machine learning techniques to build these meta\\-models presents multiple theoretical and practical challenges.



Supercomputers currently have the capacity to support the large\\-scale executions of numerous numerical simulations. This makes it possible to carry out parametric studies following a design of experiments and to generate databases of physical fields that can be used to train generic meta\\-models \\[McCabe et al., 2025]. Furthermore, since industrial equipment is fitted with sensors, we can also access precise physical measurements. Recent work in AI\\-for\\-Science has shown that neural\\-network\\-based meta\\-models can also assimilate measurements. Machine learning techniques for meta\\-models of numerical simulations of industrial equipment, with the integration of sensor measurements from that equipment, will be at the center of the research questions of this thesis.

  


**Mission confiée**
-------------------


**Thesis Problem Statement**



Modern artificial intelligence techniques will be at the heart of this thesis's research. On one hand, supervised learning will be used to build surrogate models for physical phenomena. New meta\\-model architectures based on learning may be proposed and tested on complex EDF use cases. However, this is not sufficient: can such a surrogate, learned from simulation data, predict the real\\-world behavior of an industrial piece of equipment? One challenge is to calibrate this new type of surrogate against sensor observations. Calibration involves solving an inverse problem. A promising approach is based on neural techniques known as SBI (Simulation\\-Based Inference) \\[Cranmer et al., 2020]. SBI enables the resolution of inverse problems using generative AI methods and Bayesian statistics with uncertainty quantification. However, this type of approach has not yet been used on problems as complex as an industrial piece of equipment. This thesis will be devoted to the use and development of SBI in this context. The thesis will focus on the co\\-development of neural surrogate architectures (often derived from ViT) and neural posterior estimators (of the score\\-matching type), with the aim of optimizing both accuracy and computational cost. The question of methodologies for validating results and quantifying uncertainty—critical in an industrial environment—will also be addressed. Two industrial applications will be tackled. The first concerns electrical machines like power plant alternators for which EDF has developped numerical simulators and has large sets of sensor data (measuring leaking flux for instance). The second will be in the domain of sismology.



The results developped during this PhD will be published at international venues (AI and application domain conferences and/or journals)


**Collaborative Context and Expertise**



Since 2018, EDF has been studying the construction of meta\\-models based on deep neural networks (i.e., deep learning). Initially, based on fluid simulations using Code\\_Saturne (www.code\\-saturne.org), EDF developed recognized expertise in neural\\-network\\-based learning for handling simple fluid flows with high accuracy \\[Meyer et al., 2021].



In 2022, an algorithm hybridizing POD (Proper Orthogonal Decomposition) with SVR (Support Vector Regression) was designed, with promising results \\[Ribes et al., 2022]. In 2024, an industrial use case—a power plant alternator—was successfully modeled using an evolution of this algorithm, which replaces the SVRs with a multilayer neural network \\[Ribes et al., 2024]. In 2025, it was used in an inverse\\-computation context using Bayesian inversion (MCMC methods hybridized with learning).



Inria Grenoble's Statify team is among the leading players in simulation\\-based inference (SBI), with an ambitious and structured research program since 2021\\. Its contributions span the entire methodological chain: from automatic dimension reduction via learned summary features \\[Rodrigues \\& Gramfort, 2020], to the rigorous statistical calibration of conditional probability approximators for solving inverse problems \\[Linhart et al., 2021], up to the most recent developments in flow matching to address physical model misspecification in SBI \\[Ruhlmann et al., 2026]. This progression illustrates a growing mastery of the theoretical and applied challenges of modern probabilistic inference.



Inria Grenoble's Datamove team has a long\\-standing collaboration with EDF. We co\\-developed the Melissa environment for managing large ensembles of numerical simulations, applied to sensitivity analysis \\[Terraz et al., 2017] and meta\\-model learning \\[Meyer et al., 2023]. The Datamove team has also contributed methodologies for online learning and active learning of advanced meta\\-models on supercomputers \\[Cesar et al., 2026].



The Inria Grenoble teams Datamove and Statify are partnered with EDF in a research chair centered on SBI (https://sbi4c.inria.fr), funded by the Grenoble MIAI AI institute. This thesis is part of this collaborative context, to which two complementary theses are also attached: the first focused on the methodological foundations of SBI for complex problems, and the second on large\\-scale online SBI.

* J. Linhart, A. Gramfort, P.L.C. Rodrigues. \\*L\\-C2ST: Local Diagnostics for Posterior Approximations in Simulation\\-Based Inference\\*. Accepted at NeurIPS 2023\\. arXiv:2306\\.03580
* L. Meyer, L. Poittier, A. Ribes, B. Raffin. \\*Deep Surrogate for Direct Time Fluid Dynamics\\*. Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences workshop at NeurIPS. December 2021\\.
* A. Ribes, R. Persicot, L. Meyer, J\\-P. Ducreux. \\*A hybrid Reduced Basis and Machine\\-Learning algorithm for building Surrogate Models: a first application to electromagnetism\\*. Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences workshop at NeurIPS. December 2022\\.

title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
description:
The Behavior AI team builds the AI\\-based anomaly detection behind Datadog's security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general\\-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high\\-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.

  



We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.

  



The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model's outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural\\-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. **About the team**


White Circle's fundamental research team works on the science of how AI systems fail: where agents break, why misalignment and unsafe behaviours emerge, and how to catch them before they reach the real world. **You will**

* Build adversarial environments for agents: complex, uncertain settings that sit on the boundary of agent capability and alignment, where failure is informative rather than trivial.

description:
Founded in 2020 and based in the heart of Paris, C12’s mission is to be at the center of one of the biggest technological breakthroughs of the century and change the course of history by building a universal quantum computer.
At C12, we believe that achieving a true breakthrough in quantum computing requires rethinking the fundamentals. That’s why our founders—deeply rooted in academic and engineering excellence—have chosen carbon nanotubes as the building blocks of our quantum processors. This ultra\\-pure material dramatically reduces error rates, boosts performance, and minimizes hardware overhead—key ingredients for scalable, fault\\-tolerant quantum computing. By crafting a unique approach that scales, we aim to revolutionize quantum computing just as silicon transformed classical computing.

Since our founding, we’ve raised over €25 million in funding, published 11 scientific papers, and secured 8 patents. Today, our fast\\-growing team of 80\\+, including 25 PhDs, has over 26 nationalities represented. We have our own cutting\\-edge lab spaces in Paris' historic Panthéon district, where scientists, engineers, and innovators work side\\-by\\-side to tackle some of the most exciting technical challenges of our time.

If you're passionate about shaping the future of quantum technology and want to make a real impact, C12 offers a unique environment to grow, learn, and innovate.
### **You role at C12 Quantum Electronics:**



C12 Quantum Electronics is developing a hybrid quantum architecture based on spin qubits in carbon nanotubes, coupled through a circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) platform. Our approach combines the exceptional coherence properties of carbon\\-based qubits with high\\-connectivity microwave architectures, with the goal of building a fault\\-tolerant quantum processing unit.



The Qubit Control team sits at the heart of this effort. We develop the methods that make qubits work: tuning protocols, readout strategies, gate implementations. We optimise the control and readout electronics and protocols, explore large parameter spaces, investigate the physics of the spin qubit, and translate physical insight into engineering solutions.



Working at the intersection of quantum physics, engineering, and software, you will collaborate daily with theory and the other engineering teams — all co\\-located in our Paris lab to make those interactions as direct and continuous as possible.



C12 is transitioning from a phase of scientific discovery and proof\\-of\\-concept demonstrations to one of systematic scaling. This means our focus is shifting towards automation, reproducibility, and process maturity — without sacrificing the scientific rigor and curiosity that got us here.



It is a demanding and exciting moment: we are still making new science, while simultaneously building the infrastructure that will carry us to a quantum advantage demonstration. The person joining this team will need to be both a rigorous scientist and a pragmatic builder!

  


Key responsibilities:
* Design, calibrate, and optimize DC and microwave experiments in dilution cryostats equipped with state\\-of\\-the\\-art high\\-frequency control electronics
* Develop scalable measurement and analysis workflows: well\\-documented, reproducible, and built to run with increasing autonomy
* Sustain a close feedback loop with engineering teams to continuously improve device performance
* Work closely with the theory team to connect experimental observations with physical models
* Actively collaborate with the software team to execute our automation roadmap — from experiment scheduling to data analysis — as we scale toward a full QPU
* Deepen our understanding of spin qubits in carbon nanotubes integrated within high\\-impedance cQED architectures

**La vie chez Palantir**

En conséquence, nous encourageons les employés à travailler depuis nos bureaux pour favoriser la connectivité et l’innovation. description:
#### **About us**


Spore.Bio is a deeptech startup born in 2023, building a new paradigm in quality control systems for Food \\& Beverage, Cosmetics, and Pharmaceutical factories. After spending a lot of time in factory environments, we saw the pain it was to make sure products were safe. Traditional quality control has heavy constraints and long waiting times. To change that, we decided to build Spore.Bio, a new generation of microbiological testing. Our team is dedicated to developing a cutting\\-edge solution, based on advanced photonic and deep\\-learning technologies, to detect bacterial contamination within seconds.

#### **About the role**


At the core of Spore.Bio lies a simple challenge: extracting meaningful biological information from light.


As a **Senior Optical R\\&D Engineer**, you will play a key role in defining and building the next generation of optical systems powering our platform. From novel imaging approaches to advanced photonic architectures, you will help push the boundaries of what can be measured, detected, and understood through light.


Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering, you will collaborate closely with Hardware, Microbiology, AI, and Product teams to solve some of the most challenging problems in industrial microbiology.


This is one of the most impactful technical roles at Spore.Bio, offering the opportunity to shape our technology roadmap and contribute directly to the future of our platform.

#### **Your Mission**

* Conduct comprehensive bibliographic research to design and develop a **high\\-performance photonic system** at the forefront of innovation.
* Lead the **conception, development, and prototyping** of a **multimodal biophotonics imaging platform** for a high\\-impact project.
* **Design experiments** to optimize signal quality and imaging system performance.
* **Process imaging data** and collaborate with computer vision engineers to analyze and interpret results.

#### **Your Profile**

* **Education \\& Experience:** 5–10 years of proven experience as an **optical engineer or researcher**, ideally in **life sciences imaging**. Familiarity with **microbiology** is a plus.
* **Biophotonics Expertise:** Solid understanding of **light–matter interactions**, **microscopy**, and optical system design.
* **Prototyping \\& Project Management:** Strong hands\\-on experience with **optical bench prototyping**, coupled with the ability to manage **complex, multidisciplinary projects** in demanding environments.
* **R\\&D Mindset:** Passion for innovation and for developing **new microscopy and bioimaging features**.
* **Communication:** Comfortable interacting across teams and with external partners. **English proficiency (B2 or above)** required.
* **Personality:** Energetic, proactive, mission\\-driven, and eager to make an impact.

#### **Why Join Spore Bio**

* Be part of an **innovative and rapidly growing startup** at the intersection of **biotech, photonics, and AI**.
* Work on **exciting, impactful projects** that address global challenges like antimicrobial resistance.
* Evolve in a **collaborative, stimulating work environment** with plenty of autonomy.
* Enjoy opportunities for **professional growth and continuous training**.
* **Benefits:** Meal vouchers, Gymlib access, and a great team spirit!

#### **Our Recruitment Process**

* **Fit Interview (\\~30 min):** A casual call to get to know each other, explore your experience, understand what drives you, and align on expectations. It's also your chance to ask anything about Spore Bio and the role.
* **Technical Case Study (Presentation):** A hands\\-on challenge reflecting the exact types of engineering problems you would face on the job. We care about your reasoning, methodology, and instincts—not textbook answers.
* **Culture\\-Fit Discussion:** A dedicated chat with a Spore Bio collaborator to ensure our values, vision, and team dynamics match what you're looking for.
* **On\\-site Interview \\& Lab Visit:** A comprehensive immersion day at our Paris headquarters. You will visit the optics lab and assembly area, see our systems in action, and meet the founders. This final step is as much for you to audit us as it is for us to choose you!


This is a **unique opportunity** for someone who wants to grow in a dynamic environment, take on diverse challenges, and **make a tangible impact**.


If you're excited about shaping the future of microbiology monitoring and want to be part of a **fun, visionary team**, apply now and let’s make a difference together!

-------------------


We are looking for an ambitious 3\\-year PhD candidate to join a European project, GAIA, studying the subject of biodegradable ultra low\\-power electronics. The position will start near the commencement of the project, 5\\-May 2026\\.  

The GAIA project aims to design electronics for a ubiquitous and ecologically\\-aware Internet of Things. The project will solve this with a completely revolutionary approach to electronic design by using transient and biodegradeable materials. These new devices will be able to perform computation and communication with energy harvested from the environment and from ambient wireless signals. The PhD student will be part of the design and electronic characterization of these devices as well as proof\\-of\\-concept prototype electronics that will be manufactured in more traditional solid\\-state processes.  

As part of this project, you will be expected to work closely with a multi\\-national European consortium consisting of experts in telecommunications, embedded systems, RFID, integrated circuits, and printed electronics. **Principales activités**
-------------------------


* You will be involved in state\\-of\\-the\\-art research in ambient\\-powered biodegradable RFID electronics involving both standard silicon CMOS design of ultra low\\-power processors and radio components, as well as design and characterization of radio\\-frequency, analog, mixed\\-signal, and digital electronics made out of printed electronic devices on biodegradable substrates.

------------

Watteyne Thomas / thomas.watteyne@inria.fr
